parsed.rationale: The second participating record, `MockNotificationMessage` in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift`, carries `is_test: true`. Under the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and no structural refactor should be applied. The sole meaningful difference between the two interfaces — `makeMessage:(_ notification: Notification) -> Self?` vs. `makeMessage:(_ notification: sending Notification) -> Self?` — is itself a deliberate divergence: the `sending` ownership annotation in the mock variant reflects test-context concurrency semantics that should not be unified with the production `AsyncNotificationMessage` protocol. Merging these into a shared PAT would couple production observation infrastructure to test-fixture semantics.
